title: USCIS Issues Policy Guidance on the EB-5 Reform and Integrity Act of 2022
paragraphs: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) has issuedpolicy guidancein theUSCIS Policy Manualbased on the vacatur of the EB-5 Modernization Rule and the EB-5 Reform and Integrity Act of 2022.
For more information about EB-5 reform, please see theEB-5 Questions and Answers: EB-5 Reform and Integrity Act of 2022 (updated April 2022)page.
